why: removes 2 mixin injection handler(s): check each still applies somewhere, with the same effect
reviewed: Both removed handlers were only partly preserved, so both are restored in this overlay. renderClouds HEAD: CloudRendererMixin (CloudRenderer.render) misses dimensions whose DimensionSpecialEffects.renderClouds draws the clouds, which 1.21.1's HEAD cancel also skipped; eca$skipOccludingClouds now cancels lambda$addCloudsPass$6 at its renderClouds call (the clouds pass runs after the main pass, so the flag is final). renderSky TAIL: 1.21.3 adds no sky pass when isFoggyAt (the Nether) or with SkyType NONE, so the AFTER_SKY GlobalSkyboxHook never drew there, though 1.21.1's TAIL did; it also drew over a custom renderSky, where 1.21.1 returned before TAIL. eca$addGlobalSkyboxPass now adds an eca_global_skybox pass on targets.main before addMainPass, with the FOG_SKY parameters, skipped when the custom renderSky returned true (eca$recordCustomSky) and, on a frame with no sky pass (foggy/boss-fog, SkyType NONE, blindness/darkness or fluid, where 1.21.3 never calls renderSky but 1.21.1 still asked it before the TAIL), when the dimension's DimensionSpecialEffects class overrides renderSky at all (the declaring class of its renderSky is neither DimensionSpecialEffects nor NeoForge's IDimensionSpecialEffectsExtension default; cached per class), and with an identity PoseStack because the pass runs after renderLevel pushed the view matrix onto the model-view stack; GlobalSkyboxHook's AFTER_SKY handler stands down via passOwned. renderEntity HEAD/RETURN and the renderLevel HEAD/RETURN handlers stay.
